scope: Final research disposition only. No Civic Map additions or edits in this step.
closureRules: A current park can enter the implementation set when current existence is supported and its historical Makati inventory record can be reconciled without creating a likely duplicate.
Historical names that appear to be predecessors/aliases are retained in provenance and do not automatically become separate Civic Map assets.
Official inventory entries with no distinct current identity remain unresolved and do not block implementation of the verified set.
Exact point geometry may still be verified immediately before coding where the current park is unquestionably extant but a precise mapped point is not yet frozen.

evidence.finding: Makati DES Linear Park appears as a separate 3,672 sq m park.
A project named Makati DES Linear Park was implemented by/under PRRC, linking the asset to Pasig River rehabilitation.
PRRC recorded construction/improvement of a Linear Park along Pasig River in Makati Poblacion.
A current 'Makati Linear Park' exists, while Poblacion Linear Park is independently verified on the Makati riverfront.

resolvedHolds.conclusion: Evidence strongly places Makati DES Linear Park in the Pasig River linear-park program and makes a Poblacion riverfront successor likely, but the reviewed records do not prove the exact one-to-one successor identity. Preserve as historical provenance; do not add a duplicate current pin.
